scope.note: 841 entries across 10 rooms and 46 Form subtypes; entries, not necessarily unique works. Cross-room editions remain visible as separate records.

simulation.label: Simulation
simulation.note: Systems that run: fluids, particles, cloth, crowds, physics and growth.

rendering.label: Rendering
rendering.note: Light, material, shader, atmosphere and the making of an image.

geometry.label: Geometry
geometry.note: Mesh, form, loaders, construction and spatial structure.

space.label: Space
space.note: Rooms, worlds, cameras, maps and navigable depth.

interface.label: Interface
interface.note: Screens, controls, dashboards, games and type-led interaction.

motion.label: Motion
motion.note: Animation, transitions, sequenced time and kinetic image.

image.label: Image
image.note: Photography, splats, image fields and two-dimensional visual material.

system.label: System
system.note: Engines, tools, reference shelves and the source itself.

simulate.label: Simulate
simulate.note: Solve a field or a physical system in real time.

generate.label: Generate
generate.note: Grow form from rules, seeds or procedural steps.

render.label: Render
render.note: Make light, surface, image or atmosphere the subject.

compose.label: Compose
compose.note: Arrange many pieces, meshes or panels into a whole.

explore.label: Explore
explore.note: Move through a place, a scene or a set of views.

animate.label: Animate
animate.note: Set time in motion through keyframes or transitions.

interact.label: Interact
interact.note: Answer a pointer, a key, a touch or a game rule.

scroll.label: Scroll
scroll.note: Compose time along the scroll axis.

reference.label: Reference
reference.note: Keep a source, an engine or a catalogue as the work.

threejs.label: three.js
threejs.note: The library is the visible engine; WebGL/WebGPU backend is secondary.

webgl.label: WebGL
webgl.note: WebGL first, whether raw, PlayCanvas, OGL or a framework.

dom.label: DOM/CSS
dom.note: HTML, CSS and JavaScript as the material.

blender.label: Blender
blender.note: Geometry Nodes and a rendered Blender still or loop.

other.label: Other
other.note: Tooling, native source, audio or an engine outside the named set.

ambient.label: Ambient
ambient.note: Slow, continuous, self-running; no demand on the viewer.

reactive.label: Reactive
reactive.note: Answers the pointer, the key or the player immediately.

cinematic.label: Cinematic
cinematic.note: Staged reveals, camera moves and scene changes.

playful.label: Playful
playful.note: Tactile, elastic, toy-like; a rule you can try.

static.label: Static
static.note: A still, a reference or a plate meant to be read.

rooms.label: Paper
rooms.note: The original shelf: interfaces, scenes and small games.
